passive.lne_paladins.sirens_holy_staff_a: 15% Chance to clear a negative effect on healing.
passive.lne_paladins.sirens_holy_staff_e: 10% Chance to play the Siren´s Song, the affected target is in a hypnotic stasis.
effect.lne_paladins.sirens_song.descript: The affected target is in a hypnotic stasis unable to move or perform attacks.
spell.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.name: Holy Weapon
spell.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.descripti: Enhances your physical damage and your melee hits heal you for {effect_duration} seconds.
effect.lne_paladins.holy_weapon.descript: Enhances your physical damage and your melee hits heal you, you deal extra magic damage to undead.
spell.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.name: Prevention
spell.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.descr: Invisible healing shield that activates when you fall below 20% of your max health.
effect.lne_paladins.holy_prevention.desc: Heals you when you fall below 20% max health, the heal amount enhances with effect amplifier. If you´re already under 20% when the effect is applied, the healing is reduced.
